newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's RFC Inc to be renamed MBf Inc.
newsitem.headline: Manila's RFC Inc to be renamed MBf Inc.

text.p: RFC Inc, a subsidiary of MBf Holdings Bhd of Malaysia, said on Tuesday the company will be renamed MBf Inc.
In a disclosure to the Philippine Stock Exchange, the investment holding firm said it is in the process of amending its corporate name.
Last year, Grogram Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary of MBf Capital bought 75 percent of RFC Inc.

The company said in the same advisory that while the Central Bank has approved RFC's subscription to 45 million pesos worth of shares amounting to a 30 percent stake in Unitrust Development Bank, the sale has not been completed.
